sentences.text: Roberto Gaston Orci -LRB- born July 20 , 1973 -RRB- is a Mexican-American film and television screenwriter and producer .	film	film producer
He began his longtime collaboration with Alex Kurtzman while at school in California .	Alex Kurtzman	Alex Kurtzman
Together they have been employed on television series such as Hercules : The Legendary Journeys and Xena : Warrior Princess .
In 2008 , together with J. J. Abrams , they created Fringe .	J. J. Abrams	J. J. Abrams	Fringe	Fringe (TV series)
In 2013 , they created Sleepy Hollow alongside Phillip Iscove .	Sleepy Hollow	Sleepy Hollow (TV series)

Orci and Kurtzman 's first film project was Michael Bay 's The Island , and due to that partnership they went on to write the scripts for the first three films of the Transformers film series .	film	film producer	Michael Bay	Michael Bay	The Island	The Island (2005 film)
Orci first became a film producer with 2008 's Eagle Eye and again with 2009 's The Proposal .	film	film producer	Eagle Eye	Eagle Eye	The Proposal	The Proposal (film)

He and Kurtzman since returned to working with Abrams on Mission : Impossible III and both Star Trek and Star Trek Into Darkness .	Star Trek	Star Trek (film)	Star Trek Into Darkness	Star Trek Into Darkness
Between 2005 and 2011 , Kurtzman and Orci 's film projects took revenues of more than $ 3 billion .	film	film producer

In April 2014 , Orci and Kurtzman announced that they would only collaborate in television projects , and Orci worked on the third Star Trek film , Star Trek Beyond , until being replaced the following December .	film	film producer	Star Trek	Star Trek (film)	Star Trek Beyond	Star Trek Beyond

Orci created the television series Matador for the El Rey Network , but after this was initially renewed , it was cancelled at the end of the first season .	Matador	Matador (U.S. TV series)	El Rey Network	El Rey Network
Both Kurtzman and Orci continue to work as producers on the television series Limitless and Scorpion .	Limitless	Limitless (TV series)	Scorpion	Scorpion (TV series)

Orci was awarded the Norman Lear Writer 's Award and the Raul Julia Award for Excellence , in addition to shared awards and nominations including The George Pal Memorial Award .	The George Pal Memorial Award	The George Pal Memorial Award
